turns.question: What was our repeat purchase rate from 1 to 10 October 2026: of the customers who bought in that time, what share bought more than once?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no repeat purchase rate metric, so I can't give you that share directly. The closest metrics gave, for 1 to 10 October 2026, 10 repeat customers (customers with a non-cancelled order in the period who have placed two or more orders in all) out of 17 active customers (distinct customers with at least one non-cancelled order). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
